items.headline: Feed lists 9 ADU permits, many of them garage conversions
items.summary: The feed lists 9 ADU permits issued Nov. 10–13, including garage conversions to ADUs or JADUs at 361 N 10th St, 5168 Persianwood Place, 2427 Forest Avenue, 137 Cedar Lane and 385 Via Primavera Drive The Via Primavera Dr and N 10th St permits are described as code-amnesty and code-case legalizations; the highest permit valuation among the ADUs is $143,023 for an attached ADU at 2373 Newhall Street

items.headline: Campbell commission agenda: rezone 480 Chapman from commercial to single-family
items.summary: The November 10 Planning Commission agenda listed a public hearing on a request to change 480 Chapman from Neighborhood Commercial to Low Density Residential (R-1-10 zoning). The lot already has a single-family house, and the change would end its legal nonconforming status. Staff recommended the commission forward the request to the City Council, with a tentative council date of December 1, 2026.

items.headline: Campbell planning commissioners studying permit streamlining for housing and businesses
items.summary: The November 10 agenda listed reports from two ad hoc subcommittees. One, on housing permits, plans to interview developers and other stakeholders to find bottlenecks and propose policies. The other is researching streamlining for business permits, with a focus on Conditional Use Permits.

items.headline: Planning Commission agenda: 251-unit Eden Housing project on N. Wolfe Road
items.summary: The November 10 Planning Commission agenda listed Eden Housing's request for architectural and site approval and tree removal permits for a 251-unit residential development at 10333 N. Wolfe Road. The plan includes site and trail improvements and the removal and replacement of 117 protected trees.

items.headline: Planning Commission agenda: 363 apartments proposed to replace offices on Stevens Creek Blvd
items.summary: The November 10 agenda listed The Hanover Company's proposal for a 363-unit apartment development at 19220-19300 Stevens Creek Boulevard, replacing existing office buildings. The site is Sites 5 and 6 of the city's Priority Housing Sites in the 6th Cycle Housing Element, and the project uses SB 330 and State Density Bonus law. The commission was asked to consider architectural and site approval, a parcel map, and tree removal.

items.headline: Office electrical service upgrade at 250 Holger Way tops $1.99M
items.summary: A permit was issued for an electrical service upgrade as a tenant improvement to an existing office building at 250 Holger Way, with a permit valuation of $1,990,033 — the highest valuation among the permits listed. The valuation is the declared figure on the permit, not a confirmed cost.

items.headline: Eight-story, 200-unit rental building proposed at 720 San Antonio Road
items.summary: The November 9 City Council agenda listed a prescreening request to rezone 720 San Antonio Road from Service Commercial to Planned Community/Planned Home zoning and build 200 rental units in an eight-story structure on about 1.35 acres. Prescreening is a chance for the council to give feedback before a formal application; the same agenda also listed review of 60% design plans for the Quarry Road Transit Connection.

items.headline: Historic commission to pick member for preservation ordinance consultant panel
items.summary: The November 5 Historical and Landmarks Commission agenda included selecting one commissioner to serve on the review board that chooses a consultant for the city's Historic Preservation Ordinance update. That consultant will help rewrite the rules governing alterations to the city's historic properties.
